title: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an integer overflow in send_picture() of libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c that leaves the bit…
description: FFmpeg versions prior to 9.1 have an integer overflow vulnerability in the send_picture() function within libavformat/rtpenc_vc2hq.c. This flaw causes the bit reader to lose its buffer, resulting in a NULL pointer dereference and application crash when processing large Dirac/VC-2 picture data units of approximately 256 MiB or more.
